pages.title: Lapis Singularity
pages.text: Lapis lazuli in such quantity that it collapsed into one point. It is a deep, perfect blue, and the colour seems to go down forever. Holding it feels cool and calm, like the bottom of the sea. Old painters ground this stone for ultramarine, the costliest blue there was.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Lapis is mostly lazurite, a complex silicate. I fed the Singularity Compactor enough of it that the crystal lattice collapsed into a single deep-blue point.
